register.labelZh: GET (VOLUME 3) 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: 你可以用 GET 表達把衣服收進屋內、把東西放入袋、把物件拿出來,以及穿上衣物。；get the words out、get the truth out of somebody 和 get a message through 都可以描述成功說出或傳達資料的不同情況。；get something out of something 可以描述你從課堂、興趣、旅程或活動中得到的樂趣、知識或好處。；get through 可以表示電話成功接通、用掉大量東西,或捱過一段困難的經歷。
register.summaryEn: You can use GET to talk about bringing washing inside, putting something into a bag, taking something out or putting clothes on. Get the words out, get the truth out of somebody and get a message through all describe different ways of successfully communicating information. Get something out of something helps you describe the enjoyment, knowledge or benefit you receive from a class, hobby, trip or activity. Get through can describe a successful phone call, using a large amount of something, or surviving a difficult experience.
contextsZh: 使用 GET 描述日常處理物件的動作

Talk about speaking and communicating successfully
Talk about what you gain from an experience
Use GET THROUGH for three very different real-life situations

fixedVariable.variableZh: 保留原句中的人物、事物、時間和意思。；有些 GET 表達看起來十分相似,但意思可以完全不同。請閱讀整個情境。For example:get the violin out把小提琴拿出來get the words out把話說出來get the truth out of somebody令某人說出真相get a lot out of a course從課程中獲益良多；我打電話但未能接通。We got through three bottles of water.我們喝掉了三瓶水。She got through a difficult week.她捱過了艱難的一星期。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time and meaning. Some GET expressions look almost the same but have very different meanings. Read the whole situation. Get through also has several meanings: I couldn't get through.
